I'd like to generate soft labels for the unannotated training studies using a model whose weights (and training data) are not publicly available. The model would be run only on competition data to generate those soft labels, on my own infrastructure, and would not be part of the final model training or inference notebook; the image models trained on these labels would use only public pretrained weights.
Is this permitted under Section 2.6, given the labeler itself isn't publicly accessible?
If permitted, would publishing the resulting label file as a public Kaggle dataset before the entry deadline satisfy the "publicly available and equally accessible" requirement?
For winner verification, would delivering the label file plus a description of how it was produced satisfy the "training code … capable of generating the winning Submission" requirement, or must the labeler itself be delivered?
